_doc: Facts (income, household, age, status, location) stated in languages other than English/Spanish. Before engine/facts_i18n.jac these came back empty, so the follow-up question asked for what the person had already said. Includes traps: rent amounts that are not income, 'not a citizen', an abusive partner who is not in the household, a child's age, digits in other scripts, 万 multipliers, hourly/weekly pay, a Latin city name inside Chinese, Tamil case endings.
